title: Remittance Schedule of the Equity Desk: Cash Portion Methods, Minimums and Offset Order by Equity Class
content:
The equity desk delivers the cash portion of a declared allocation under Membership and Patronage Equity by the methods listed against the class and by no others, and applies the offset order shown where the class allows offsetting.

| Class | Methods the class allows | Cash portion below which nothing is issued, USD | Cash portion applied against what the member owes | Order accounts are offset in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | cheque; credit to the crop input account | 10.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |
| Class A Voting Membership | cheque; bank transfer; credit to the crop input account; offset to balance | 10.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | cheque; bank transfer; credit to the crop input account; offset to balance | 25.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | cheque; bank transfer | 10.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | cheque; bank transfer; offset to balance | 10.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | cheque; bank transfer | 0.00 | yes | crop input account, then refined fuels, then feed |

Every class of Membership and Patronage Equity carries offsetting, and every class carries the same offset order: what stands against the crop input account is taken first, what stands on refined fuels next, and what stands on feed last.

Two classes allow the cash portion to be credited onto the crop input account; four do not. Two classes allow offset to balance as a delivery method in its own right; four do not. Only two methods, cheque and bank transfer, are open on every class that lists more than one.

**Points of judgement.** A cash portion of 18.00 on the Class B Preferred Equity Membership falls under that class's figure of 25.00 in the third column; the same 18.00 on the Class A Voting Membership stands above that class's figure of 10.00. On the Estate Retirement Equity Holding the column reads 0.00, so no cash portion is too small to be issued.
